name: synccanvas
description: SyncCanvas - real-time collaborative digital whiteboard (Next.js + Node.js + Socket.io)

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @synccanvas/shared && npm run build -w @synccanvas/db
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev:apps
scripts.dev:local: npm run build:packages && node scripts/prepare-local-db.mjs && pglite-server --db=./.data/pglite --port=5433 -m 20 --run "node scripts/dev-local-run.mjs" --include-database-url
scripts.dev:apps: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @synccanvas/server" "npm run dev -w @synccanvas/client"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @synccanvas/server && npm run build -w @synccanvas/client
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run start -w @synccanvas/server" "npm run start -w @synccanvas/client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @synccanvas/shared && npm run typecheck -w @synccanvas/db && npm run typecheck -w @synccanvas/server && npm run typecheck -w @synccanvas/client
